--!strict
-- Physics2D.scene's Ball (Docs/Decisions/0032-m21-contract.md decisions 9 and 17): the MoveX action pushes it along X
-- and each press of Jump kicks it up, so the Physics2D replay's bodies depend on its input.
export type Pusher = ScriptInstance & {
	Kicks: number,
}

local PUSH = 30 -- newtons per unit of MoveX
local KICK = 14 -- newton seconds

local Pusher = {}

function Pusher.OnCreate(self: Pusher)
	self.Kicks = 0
end

function Pusher.OnFixedUpdate(self: Pusher, _dt: number)
	local body = self.Entity.RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
	local move = Input.GetAxis("MoveX")
	if move ~= 0 then
		body:AddForce(vector.create(move * PUSH, 0, 0))
	end
	if Input.IsActionPressed("Jump") then
		self.Kicks += 1
		body:AddImpulse(vector.create(0, KICK, 0))
	end
end

return Script.Define("Pusher", Pusher)

--!strict
-- Physics2D.scene (Docs/Decisions/0032-m21-contract.md decisions 8 to 11 and 13): the 2D world starts at the project's
-- Physics2D.Gravity, keeps every body in its plane, and delivers OnCollisionEnter2D, OnCollisionExit2D,
-- OnTriggerEnter2D and OnTriggerExit2D to both sides of a pair, each enter before its exit, in every run mode.
local Contacts2DScript = require("../../Scripts/Physics2D/Contacts2D")
local Support = require("../Api/Support")

-- The kinds of `entity`'s recorded events with `other`, in arrival order.
local function kinds(entity: Entity, other: string): string
	local recorder = entity:GetScript("Contacts2D") :: Contacts2DScript.Contacts2D
	local found: { string } = {}
	for _, event in recorder.Events do
		if event.Other == other then
			table.insert(found, event.Kind)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(found, ",")
end

return Test.Suite("Physics2D", function()
	Test.Case("the 2D world starts at the project's gravity and keeps its bodies in the plane", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Physics2D.GetGravity(), vector.create(0, -12, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(90)
		for _, name in { "Ball", "Crate", "Wedge" } do
			local entity = Support.Find(name)
			Test.ExpectEqual(entity.Transform.WorldPosition.z, 0, name .. " stays on z = 0")
			local rotation = entity.Transform.WorldRotation
			Test.ExpectEqual(rotation.x, 0, name .. " turns about Z only")
			Test.ExpectEqual(rotation.y, 0, name .. " turns about Z only")
		end
		Test.Expect(Support.Find("Ball").Transform.WorldPosition.x > -8, "the ball rolled off at its initial velocity")
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.Find("Lift").Transform.WorldPosition, vector.create(8, 2, 0), 0, "an unmoved kinematic body stays")
	end)

	Test.Case("a resting ball enters the floor and leaves it when lifted", function()
		local ball = Support.Find("Ball")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(ball, "Floor"), "CollisionEnter2D")
		Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(Support.Find("Floor"), "Ball"), "CollisionEnter2D", "both sides are called")
		local recorder = ball:GetScript("Contacts2D") :: Contacts2DScript.Contacts2D
		local normal = recorder.Events[1].Normal :: vector
		Test.ExpectEqual(normal.z, 0, "the contact normal lies in the plane")
		Test.ExpectNear(math.abs(normal.y), 1, 1e-3, "the floor pushes along Y")
		local body = ball.RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
		body:Teleport(vector.create(-8, 9, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(ball, "Floor"), "CollisionEnter2D,CollisionExit2D")
		Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(Support.Find("Floor"), "Ball"), "CollisionEnter2D,CollisionExit2D")
	end)

	Test.Case("a ball passing through a sensor enters and leaves it", function()
		local ball = Support.Find("Ball")
		local body = ball.RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
		for _, sensor in { "BoxSensor", "CircleSensor", "WedgeSensor" } do
			local zone = Support.Find(sensor)
			body:Teleport(zone.Transform.WorldPosition)
			body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
			Test.WaitTicks(2)
			Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(zone, "Ball"), "TriggerEnter2D", sensor .. " sees the ball enter")
			Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(ball, sensor), "TriggerEnter2D", "the ball sees " .. sensor)
			body:Teleport(vector.create(0, 12, 0))
			Test.WaitTicks(2)
			Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(zone, "Ball"), "TriggerEnter2D,TriggerExit2D", sensor .. " sees the ball leave")
			Test.ExpectEqual(kinds(ball, sensor), "TriggerEnter2D,TriggerExit2D")
		end
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The RigidBody2D proxy (Docs/Decisions/0032-m21-contract.md decision 13): forces, impulses, velocities, teleports,
-- sleep and kinematic moves act in the plane, vectors' Z ignored and angles in degrees about +Z, and every field reads
-- and writes.
local Support = require("./Support")

local FIXED = 1 / 64

-- Places the Ball in free space with no gravity and no motion.
local function float(ball: Entity): RigidBody2D
	local body = ball.RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
	Physics2D.SetGravity(vector.zero)
	body:Teleport(vector.create(0, 8, 0), 0)
	body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
	body:SetAngularVelocity(0)
	return body
end

return Test.Suite("Api.RigidBody2D", function()
	Test.Case("velocities, impulses and forces move a dynamic body in the plane", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1) -- bodies appear at the first step's pre-step
		local ball = Support.Find("Ball")
		local body = float(ball)
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.create(1, 2, 3))
		body:SetAngularVelocity(1.5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(body:GetLinearVelocity(), vector.create(1, 2, 0), "Z is ignored")
		Test.ExpectEqual(body:GetAngularVelocity(), 1.5)
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
		body:SetAngularVelocity(0)
		body:AddImpulse(vector.create(4, 0, 9))
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectNear(body:GetLinearVelocity(), vector.create(2, 0, 0), 0.05, "an impulse of 4 N s on 2 kg")
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
		body:AddForce(vector.create(0, 128, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectNear(body:GetLinearVelocity().y, 128 / 2 * FIXED, 0.05, "a force acts for one step")
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
		body:AddAngularImpulse(0.1)
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(body:GetAngularVelocity() > 0, "an angular impulse turns the body counter-clockwise")
		body:SetAngularVelocity(0)
		body:AddTorque(-2)
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(body:GetAngularVelocity() < 0, "a negative torque turns it clockwise")
		body:SetAngularVelocity(0)
		body:AddForceAtPosition(vector.create(0, 20, 0), ball.Transform.WorldPosition + vector.create(0.5, 0, 0))
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(body:GetLinearVelocity().y > 0 and body:GetAngularVelocity() > 0, "an off-centre force pushes and turns")
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.Transform.WorldPosition.z, 0, "the body stays on its plane")
	end)

	Test.Case("teleports, sleep and kinematic moves", function()
		local ball = Support.Find("Ball")
		local body = float(ball)
		body:Teleport(vector.create(-2, 6, 4), 90)
		Test.ExpectEqual(ball.Transform.WorldPosition, vector.create(-2, 6, 0), "the entity keeps its Z")
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(ball.Transform.WorldRotation, Quat.AngleAxis(90, vector.create(0, 0, 1)), 1e-5, "the angle turns about +Z")
		body:Teleport(vector.create(-3, 6, 0))
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(ball.Transform.WorldRotation, Quat.AngleAxis(90, vector.create(0, 0, 1)), 1e-5, "an omitted angle is kept")
		Test.ExpectEqual(type(body:IsSleeping()), "boolean")
		body:WakeUp()
		Test.ExpectEqual(body:IsSleeping(), false)
		local lift = Support.Find("Lift")
		local kinematic = lift.RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
		kinematic:MoveKinematic(vector.create(8, 3, 0), 30)
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.ExpectNear(lift.Transform.WorldPosition, vector.create(8, 3, 0), 0.001, "the kinematic body reached its target")
		Support.ExpectQuatNear(lift.Transform.WorldRotation, Quat.AngleAxis(30, vector.create(0, 0, 1)), 1e-4, "and its angle")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			kinematic:AddForce(vector.one)
		end), "forces need a dynamic body")
	end)

	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy", function()
		local body = Support.Find("Crate").RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "Mass", 2.5, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "Friction", 0.8, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "Restitution", 0.4, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "LinearDamping", 0.1, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "AngularDamping", 0.2, 1e-6)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "GravityFactor", 0.5, 1e-6)
		for _, quality: MotionQuality in { "LinearCast", "Discrete" } do
			Support.RoundTrip(body, "MotionQuality", quality)
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(body, "AllowSleeping", false), true)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(body, "FixedRotation", false), true, "the scene keeps the crate upright")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(body, "Layer", "Ball"), "Default")
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "MaxLinearVelocity", 100, 1e-4)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "MaxAngularVelocity", 120, 1e-4)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(body, "EnhancedInternalEdgeRemoval", false), true)
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "InitialLinearVelocity", vector.create(0, 1, 0))
		Support.RoundTrip(body, "InitialAngularVelocity", 2, 1e-6)
		for _, kind: BodyType in { "Kinematic", "Static", "Dynamic" } do
			Support.RoundTrip(body, "Type", kind)
		end
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			body.Mass = 0
		end), "a zero mass is refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Physics2D module (Docs/Decisions/0032-m21-contract.md decision 13): rays and overlaps in the plane with hit
-- identities, layer masks and the session's 2D gravity, which starts at the project's [0, -12].
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.Physics2D", function()
	Test.Case("rays find the crate on the floor with its identity and distance", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(1) -- bodies appear at the first step's pre-step
		local crate = Support.Find("Crate")
		local floor = Support.Find("Floor")
		local origin, down = vector.create(-2, 5, 3), vector.create(0, -1, 0)
		local hit = Physics2D.Raycast(origin, down, 20)
		Test.Expect(hit ~= nil, "the ray hits")
		local first = hit :: RaycastHit
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Entity, crate)
		Test.ExpectEqual(first.Body, crate)
		Test.ExpectNear(first.Distance, 4.2, 0.02, "the crate's top is at 0.8")
		Test.ExpectNear(first.Point, vector.create(-2, 0.8, 0), 0.02, "the point lies in the plane")
		Test.ExpectNear(first.Normal, vector.create(0, 1, 0), 0.001)
		local all = Physics2D.RaycastAll(origin, down, 20)
		Test.ExpectEqual(#all, 2, "the crate and the floor")
		Test.ExpectEqual(all[1].Entity, crate)
		Test.ExpectEqual(all[2].Entity, floor)
		Test.Expect(all[1].Distance < all[2].Distance, "sorted by distance")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Physics2D.Raycast(origin, vector.create(0, 1, 0), 20), nil, "nothing above")
	end)

	Test.Case("layer masks select what queries see", function()
		local origin, down = vector.create(-2, 5, 0), vector.create(0, -1, 0)
		Test.Expect(Physics2D.Raycast(origin, down, 20, Physics.LayerMask("Default")) ~= nil, "the crate is on Default")
		local track = Physics2D.Raycast(origin, down, 20, Physics.LayerMask("Track"))
		Test.Expect(track ~= nil and (track :: RaycastHit).Entity == Support.Find("Floor"), "the floor is on Track")
		Test.ExpectEqual(Physics2D.Raycast(origin, down, 20, Physics.LayerMask("Debris")), nil, "nothing on Debris")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Physics2D.RaycastAll(origin, down, 20, 0), 0)
	end)

	Test.Case("overlaps list colliders in UUID order", function()
		local crate = Support.Find("Crate")
		local around = Physics2D.OverlapCircle(vector.create(-2, 0.4, 0), 0.3)
		Test.Expect(table.find(around, crate) ~= nil, "the crate overlaps its own centre")
		local box = Physics2D.OverlapBox(vector.create(-2, 0, 0), vector.create(0.7, 0.7, 0), 45)
		Test.Expect(#box >= 2, "the crate and the floor")
		for index = 2, #box do
			Test.Expect(box[index - 1].ID < box[index].ID, "sorted by UUID")
		end
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Physics2D.OverlapBox(vector.create(0, 50, 0), vector.one), 0, "nothing high above")
		Test.ExpectEqual(#Physics2D.OverlapCircle(vector.create(-2, 0.4, 0), 0.3, Physics.LayerMask("Debris")), 0)
	end)

	Test.Case("gravity starts at the project setting and a script can change it", function()
		Test.ExpectEqual(Physics2D.GetGravity(), vector.create(0, -12, 0))
		Physics2D.SetGravity(vector.create(0, -6, 5))
		Test.ExpectEqual(Physics2D.GetGravity(), vector.create(0, -6, 0), "Z is ignored")
		local ball = Support.Find("Ball")
		local body = ball.RigidBody2D :: RigidBody2D
		body:Teleport(vector.create(0, 10, 0))
		body:SetLinearVelocity(vector.zero)
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local before = body:GetLinearVelocity().y
		Test.WaitTicks(4)
		Test.ExpectNear(body:GetLinearVelocity().y - before, -6 * 4 / 64, 0.02, "the ball falls at the new gravity")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(Physics2D.SetGravity, vector.create(0, math.huge, 0)), "infinite gravity is refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The BoxCollider2D proxy: every field read and written, and a resized box reshapes the body.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.BoxCollider2D", function()
	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy and reshapes the body", function()
		local crate = Support.Find("Crate")
		local box = crate.BoxCollider2D :: BoxCollider2D
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "HalfExtents", vector.create(0.6, 1, 0)), vector.create(0.6, 0.4, 0))
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "Offset", vector.create(0, 0.25, 0)), vector.zero)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "Angle", 30, 1e-5), 0)
		box.Angle = 0
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(box, "IsTrigger", true), false)
		box.IsTrigger = false
		box.Offset = vector.zero
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local hit = Physics2D.Raycast(vector.create(-2, 5, 0), vector.create(0, -1, 0), 20, Physics.LayerMask("Default"))
		Test.Expect(hit ~= nil, "the reshaped crate is hit")
		Test.Expect((hit :: RaycastHit).Point.y > 1, "the taller box reaches higher")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			box.HalfExtents = vector.create(0, 1, 0)
		end), "half extents below 1 mm are refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The CircleCollider2D proxy: every field read and written, and a larger circle reaches further.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.CircleCollider2D", function()
	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy and reshapes the sensor", function()
		local sensor = Support.Find("CircleSensor")
		local circle = sensor.CircleCollider2D :: CircleCollider2D
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(circle, "Radius", 1.5, 1e-6), 0.75)
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(circle, "Offset", vector.create(0, 0.5, 0), 1e-6), vector.create(0.25, 0, 0), 1e-6)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(circle, "IsTrigger", false), true)
		circle.IsTrigger = true
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local position = sensor.Transform.WorldPosition
		local found = Physics2D.OverlapCircle(position + vector.create(0, 1.8, 0), 0.1, Physics.LayerMask("Trigger"))
		Test.Expect(table.find(found, sensor) ~= nil, "the larger, raised circle reaches 1.8 above its entity")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			circle.Radius = 0
		end), "a zero radius is refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The PolygonCollider2D proxy: every field read and written, and new points reshape the body.
local Support = require("./Support")

return Test.Suite("Api.PolygonCollider2D", function()
	Test.Case("every field reads and writes through the proxy and reshapes the body", function()
		local wedge = Support.Find("Wedge")
		local polygon = wedge.PolygonCollider2D :: PolygonCollider2D
		local points = polygon.Points
		Test.ExpectEqual(#points, 3)
		Test.ExpectNear(points[3], vector.create(0.6, 0.5, 0), 1e-6, "the authored wedge")
		local square = { vector.create(-1, -0.5, 0), vector.create(1, -0.5, 0), vector.create(1, 1.5, 0), vector.create(-1, 1.5, 0) }
		polygon.Points = square
		Test.ExpectEqual(#polygon.Points, 4)
		Test.ExpectNear(polygon.Points[3], vector.create(1, 1.5, 0), 1e-6, "Points reads back what was written")
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(polygon, "Offset", vector.create(0.25, 0, 0), 1e-6), vector.create(0.05, 0, 0), 1e-6)
		Test.ExpectNear(Support.RoundTrip(polygon, "Angle", 0, 1e-6), 5, 1e-5)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Support.RoundTrip(polygon, "IsTrigger", true), false)
		polygon.IsTrigger = false
		Test.WaitTicks(1)
		local position = wedge.Transform.WorldPosition
		local found = Physics2D.OverlapCircle(position + vector.create(0.25, 1.2, 0), 0.05, Physics.LayerMask("Default"))
		Test.Expect(table.find(found, wedge) ~= nil, "the taller polygon reaches 1.2 above its entity")
		Test.Expect(not pcall(function()
			polygon.Points = { vector.zero, vector.one }
		end), "fewer than 3 points are refused")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The Physics2D replay's recording suite (Docs/Decisions/0032-m21-contract.md decision 17; Modes Editor): a planned input
-- list pushes the Ball right into the crate and through the box sensor, kicks it up and pushes it back, so every 2D
-- body it reaches and the sensors' events depend on the input. It only reads the scene and injects input.
-- Replays2D.jsonl records the replay over the same input with input.record around a play.step.
local Contacts2DScript = require("../../Scripts/Physics2D/Contacts2D")
local PusherScript = require("../../Scripts/Physics2D/Pusher")

type Step = { Tick: number, Action: string, State: InputEventState?, Value: number? }
local Plan: { Step } = {
	{ Tick = 8, Action = "MoveX", Value = 1 },
	{ Tick = 70, Action = "Jump", State = "Tap" },
	{ Tick = 110, Action = "MoveX", Value = -1 },
	{ Tick = 150, Action = "Jump", State = "Tap" },
	{ Tick = 190, Action = "MoveX", Value = 0 },
}

return Test.Suite("Record.Physics2D", function()
	Test.Case("pushes the ball through the sensor and back", function()
		local found = Scene.FindByName("Ball")
		Test.Expect(found ~= nil, "Physics2D.scene has a Ball")
		local ball = found :: Entity
		local tick = 0
		for _, step in Plan do
			Test.WaitTicks(step.Tick - tick)
			tick = step.Tick
			Test.InjectAction(step.Action, step.State, step.Value)
		end
		Test.WaitTicks(260 - tick)
		local pusher = ball:GetScript("Pusher") :: PusherScript.Pusher
		Test.ExpectEqual(pusher.Kicks, 2, "both kicks were pressed")
		local sensor = (Scene.FindByName("BoxSensor") :: Entity):GetScript("Contacts2D") :: Contacts2DScript.Contacts2D
		Test.Expect(#sensor.Events >= 1, "the pushed ball reached the box sensor")
	end)
end)
